_comment: godot-cpp build profile for the worldstream GDExtension.
The extension registers its own RefCounted classes and passes Variant
Array, Dictionary, String, Vector3). It never calls an engine class
method, so the generated bindings for the ~900 engine classes are dead
weight: the default build compiles 1 964 source files, this one compiles
a few dozen, and both produce an extension with identical behaviour.
godot-cpp always keeps the classes its own core needs (ClassDB,
FileAccess, Image, XMLParser, WorkerThreadPool, Semaphore), so listing
RefCounted brings Object and those with it. The remaining entries are
the classes godot-cpp's own core sources include directly (print_string
uses OS, the thread pool types use Mutex and Semaphore); they are not
optional, because the trim applies to the headers godot-cpp compiles
against itself. global_constants.hpp is generated unconditionally.
